newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PHS operators' investment seen up -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan PHS operators' investment seen up -- paper.

text.p: Total capital investment by Japan's personal handy phone system (PHS) operators is expected to nearly double to more than 1.47 trillion yen this fiscal year compared with last year, a Japanese economic daily said on Thursday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected 98 percent year-on-year rise in investment in the year to March 31, 1997 was due to unexpectedly robust demand.
The paper's estimate is larger than the 1.28 trillion yen combined capital investment PHS operators forecast earlier this year.
It quoted the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications as saying on Wednesday that the number of PHS subscribers in Japan was 20.5 million as of the end of October.
The PHS, which was launched in July last year, is a technology halfway between cellular and cordless phones, with lower costs than the former and more range than the latter.
